name: Routing — Serverless catalog model
summary: Serverless connection (Phi, Mistral, Llama, etc. served by Foundry's catalog). Uses '{conn}/{model}' prefix but is NOT BYOM.
description: Serverless catalog routing uses the same `{connection}/{deployment}` model prefix shape, but the upstream model is Foundry-hosted rather than customer-hosted behind APIM. It helps users distinguish BYOM syntax from true bring-your-own-model ownership of the upstream endpoint.
notes:
Verified end-to-end when `AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_SERVERLESS` and `SERVERLESS_MODEL` point at a serverless catalog connection. See `test.py`.

The prefix shape matches BYOM, but the upstream is Foundry-hosted rather than customer-hosted.
